description:
Think the scene is airtight at first glance?

Every detail may look ordinary, but one small spot is waiting for your detective eye.

Perfect Crime Case Files is a casual picture puzzle game where you examine each case image and identify the single correct area hidden within it.

How to play:
・Study the illustration carefully
・Look for the one place that matches the question
・Move the cursor or tap the spot to answer

There are no long rules to learn. Just observe, think, and trust your instincts.

Whether you notice it straight away or need a second look, each case gives you that satisfying “aha!” moment.

Perfect for a quick brain-teaser between tasks or a relaxed mystery session on the sofa.

Button controls and touch controls are supported, so play in the style that suits you.
